title: Release notes, thanks and a to-do

blocks.text: Signed reports: inspectors can sign an inspection on the device, and the report shows who signed and when.
Sync status: every inspection shows queued, sent or needs attention, and the app shows how many are waiting to send. No spinners.
Sending feedback: Settings > Help > Send feedback. Crash reports go to the same place and include the device model, nothing else.

Offline sync conflict: if the same inspection is edited on two devices while offline, one set of edits can be overwritten. A fix is in progress. For now, please edit each inspection on one device only.
Thanks to our 41 beta testers. Your reports and comments shaped this build.
Note to self: update Known issues after Thursday's check-in with Angela and Balthasar (Android crash fix, slow-wifi photos).
